user.title: Tiered / TOU Electricity Rate Calculator
user.description: Configure your fixed-rate electricity plan (tiered, time-of-use, or both). Designed for North America, Caribbean, Latin America, Asia & Africa utilities.

tiers.title: Consumption Tiers (Increasing Block)
tiers.description:
Enter tiers as max_kWh:rate pairs, comma-separated.
Example for Aruba Elmar: 500:0.3431,1000:0.3531,99999:0.4645
Example for Mexico CFE-style: 75:1.12,140:1.37,99999:4.00

tou.title: Time-of-Use Periods
tou.description:
Enter periods as name|start|end|rate|weekdays_only separated by semicolons.
Example (Jamaica JPS style): peak|18:00|22:00|0.35|true;partial|06:00|18:00|0.28|true;offpeak|22:00|06:00|0.22|false

error.invalid_tiers: Could not parse tiers. Use format: 200:0.25,500:0.32,99999:0.41
error.invalid_tou: Could not parse TOU periods. Use format: name|HH:MM|HH:MM|rate|true/false;...

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured
